credential_boundary.keychain_service: copilot-cli per current official documentation; exact frozen-artifact lookup unobserved
credential_boundary.normal_keychain_access: trusted only through hash-verified vendor CLI and com.apple.securityd
credential_boundary.token_handling: never extracted, copied, logged, or persisted

selection_policy.underlying_identity: record actual identity when structured ACP data exposes it; otherwise report unobserved
selection_policy.vendor_managed_retries: allowed within one prompt and 60-second process/network ceiling; internal request count unobserved

network_policy.policy: official Copilot authentication and provider destinations; not a claim that frozen-version endpoints are exhaustively known

containment.network: local CONNECT proxy only; verify official host and matching TLS SNI before external dial
containment.subprocess_escape: forks inherit this sandbox; allow exec only to exact frozen binary; deny shell exec
containment.keychain: allow only com.apple.securityd lookup; vendor-owned read is not item-filtered

stop_conditions: authentication or Auto selection cannot be established before prompt
owned process group or proxy thread survives deadline
